title: [GMCP 203.048.01] Contract: Independent GMCP qualification and continuously complete release gate
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-048-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: One hermetic qualification command reconstructs the requirements ledger, builds clean artifacts, runs unit/integration/conformance/extension/interop/security/fuzz/platform/performance/recovery/doc tests, verifies evidence provenance, and emits a signed human-readable scorecard. Release is allowed only with 100% applicable requirements traced and passing, zero unexplained compatibility gaps, zero unresolved critical/high security findings and every VC-203 mastery gate green; new standards or accepted metrics automatically reopen qualification until classified. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
